query: Hi there, I picked up this cool phone last week that came with a free limited-edition neon phone charm, and I’ve been having total trouble getting any mobile data or calls to work right now. I checked and airplane mode is on, my network preference is set wrong, Wi-Fi calling isn’t working properly, I already used up all my data for the month, I think my SIM card might be loose, and I’m traveling abroad right now with roaming turned off, can you help me figure out how to fix this?
